Overview

Swan Learning Center is a tutoring centre in Charlotte, North Carolina, offering reading, writing, maths, test preparation and summer programs. Its site ran on Wix. I migrated and rebuilt it in WordPress with Elementor, wired its enquiry forms into the CRMs the team uses, and planned the SEO side of the move so the switch wouldn't cost them search visibility.

The challenge

For a local education business the website is the main source of enquiries, so a platform change carries real risk: every old URL that stops resolving loses search equity, and every form that isn't tracked is a lead nobody follows up. The rebuild had to improve the platform without breaking either.

Approach

  1. Plan the SEO migration first

    Planned the SEO migration around a 301 redirect map from the old Wix URLs to their new WordPress equivalents.

  2. Rebuild in WordPress

    Rebuilt the site in WordPress and Elementor so the team can maintain it themselves.

  3. Close the lead loop

    Connected the site's forms to HubSpot and GoHighLevel for lead tracking and follow-up.

  4. Measure conversions

    Set up external conversion measurement so enquiries can be attributed.

  5. Stay on

    Continued with ongoing website maintenance after launch.

What I delivered

  • Full Wix → WordPress migration and rebuild
  • Elementor build
  • SEO migration plan with 301 redirects
  • HubSpot and GoHighLevel form integrations
